pokemon.anchorRule: last SAME-condition native quote amount times median of identifiable connected factor ratios for every calendar date in the target trailing window, each ratio anchored at that actual native quote date; preserve actual target-window medians
pokemon.factorWindowSupportMeaning: identifiable connected factor-ratio calendar days in the target window; group gaps may use disclosed connected global factors, not invented own-condition prices
pokemon.fallbackRule: same connected group component first; group gap uses last group movement then connected global movement; disconnected group uses connected global ratio; otherwise unknown
pokemon.anchorAgeMeaning: days since the exact last SAME-condition native quote; factor anchor is that native quote date
pokemon.fitWeightRule: actual economic initialQuantity times prior-cutoff referencePrice; normalized price score equals fixed virtual-quantity native-currency PPML score
